Thanks for sending back the redlines. I reviewed the latest order form and have three asks to close the loop with Procurement and Finance:

1) Invoice cadence & net terms — our standard is net45 for new enterprise commitments. Can you confirm if Acme has flexibility for net45? If not, please indicate whether net30 is a hard requirement and whether that's for the whole term or the first invoice only.

2) Invoice recipient / entity split — a few of your redlines suggest US/EU split. We can support split invoicing, but we need a clear mapping of which invoices should go to Acme US vs Acme EU and the corresponding billing addresses/tax IDs.

3) Tax evidence — for EU invoices we require a valid VAT certificate or EU reverse-charge confirmation; for US entities we need a completed W-9. I've attached a redlined orderform (redlined_orderform_v3.pdf) with comments on the invoice section.

Can you loop in the procurement contact who can confirm PO cadence and billing entity mapping? If you can confirm answers to (1)-(3) by EOD Friday, we can finalize legal's redline and push for signature next week.

Hi all — legal review notes below (high level). See attached tax checklist for Finance.

1) Net terms — Redwood’s standard MSA language is net45. Operationally we can accept net30 as a concession in the Order Form under these conditions:
   - Net30 for initial 90 days only, after which terms revert to net45 for the remainder of the term; OR
   - Net30 in perpetuity if Acme agrees to an early-pay fee (1.0% of invoice) or provides a rolling 30-day payment guarantee (e.g., irrevocable payment milestone).

2) Invoice split / billing entity mapping — we need explicit invoice mapping lines in the Order Form (line-itemized usage buckets) or separate invoice recipients per billing address. Recommended language: "Invoices for EMEA usage shall be issued to Acme Netherlands B.V. (VAT ID NL999999999B01); all other invoices shall be issued to Acme, Inc. (EIN 12-3456789)."

3) Tax evidence — For EU invoices we require either: (a) a valid EU VAT registration certificate on file, or (b) completed EU reverse-charge declaration per local regs. For US invoices: W-9 (or equivalent) and tax remit details. Please provide these as attachments to the order packet.

4) PO / reference — acceptable to reference PO_12345 in the order form; please confirm if PO requires an invoice attachment with signed delivery acceptance.

I attached the tax evidence checklist (tax_evidence_requirements.docx). Once we have the VAT certificate and W-9, Legal will insert the invoice-recipient language into the redline and return.

-Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy, Redwood Inference
